#### Dividing the logits

Take the [logits](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-logits) $\vz = (2, 1, 0)$.
Of the [softmax](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/multiclass-logistic-regression.html#def-softmax)es of $\vz / 0.5$, $\vz$ and $\vz / 2$,
which gives the first symbol the most probability?

:::
